evidence.quote: Since its founding in 1964, Ushio has established itself as a global leader in manufacturing specialised industrial light sources || Headquartered in the Netherlands, with offices in France and the UK, a sales and logistics hub in Germany, and a cutting-edge manufacturing plant in Poland, Ushio Europe brings local expertise directly to its clients || enables Ushio to deliver reliable and innovative light sources that empower countless industries worldwide, from healthcare and advanced manufacturing to semiconductor production
